args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS under valid ownership. Reuse the completed text-only run and any equivalent committed catalogue-specific packet. Apply the documented CAD prerequisites to two fictional cases: a diagnostic-only inquiry and an explicit commission request. Produce a copy-ready bilingual response for each. If catalogue-specific terms or authority are missing, use a nonbinding clarification that identifies the exact missing evidence. Treat the public price hypothesis as unvalidated and reuse welfare documentation only for the administrative sequence. Save and read back the decision table and responses before closure with a lesson. Keep diagnostic eligibility, accepted order, deposit confirmation and Treasury posting separate. No external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.

description: The catalogue text-only rehearsal is complete and provides a tested diagnostic workflow for a real inquiry. The next step is to prepare the operator handoff for a commission and verify whether the live terms support paid escalation through the administrative CAD route. The item 4 pilot still depends on an authorized operator’s send-or-decline decision. A redacted send receipt or an eligible inbound inquiry would change the next acquisition step. Commercial feedback is available, with zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The order register is unavailable, and Treasury reports zero verified revenue and zero available cash. Use the subscription tools to advance the existing offer and preserve independent review for any public revision.
